name: native-model-owned-postgres-stop
command: python3 -c 'import json,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; o=json.loads(Path(".agents/audits/.local/sdk-local-postgres-owner.json").read_text()); local=Path(".agents/audits/.local").resolve(); data=Path(o["data"]).resolve(); binary=Path(o["binary"]).resolve(); assert o["owned"] is True and o["port"]==56818 and data.is_relative_to(local) and binary.is_relative_to(local); lines=(data/"postmaster.pid").read_text().splitlines(); assert Path(lines[1]).resolve()==data and lines[3]=="56818"; subprocess.run([str(binary/"pg_ctl"),"-D",str(data),"-m","fast","-w","-t","30","stop"],check=True); assert not (data/"postmaster.pid").exists(); print(json.dumps({"stopped":True,"port":56818,"dataRetained":data.is_dir()}))'
